name: QiYi Warrior 3x3 V2 (Magnetic)
description: The QiYi Warrior 3x3 V2 is a magnetic 3x3 speed cube built for cubers moving past the basics and chasing faster times. A 48-magnet corner-edge positioning system adds assisted alignment and stability, while a frosted surface and bright stickerless colors keep solving comfortable through long practice sessions.
features: Grows with your solving: The upgraded magnetic positioning helps you move from learning the basics toward quicker, more consistent solves.
Stronger magnetic feel: At 65g with a stronger magnetic pull than the original Warrior, pieces click into place and non-turning layers stay put.
Ready out of the box: Comes with an adjustment screwdriver, a cube stand, and a layer-by-layer solving tutorial, so there's nothing else to buy to get started.
Beginner-friendly colors: Six bright, distinct stickerless colors make inspection quick and color recognition easy.
Adjustable tension: The included screwdriver lets you dial in compression to match your turning preference, simple enough for a first-time tuner.
48-magnet positioning: Corner and edge magnets work together for assisted alignment and a stable, predictable turning feel.
